name: Major cyber incidents
summary: Supermarket freezer attacks hit 11 EU countries; Binance theft largest on record
state: Cyberattacks on 2–3 Nov caused refrigeration failures in supermarkets in 11 EU countries, forcing food to be discarded (AFP via The Citizen). Check Point's 2 Nov report lists the $6.3bn Binance theft, a breach of 4.9 million records at Florida's education department and actively exploited flaws in Drupal Commerce and Cisco firewalls.
for_you: Apply software updates promptly and follow NCSC guidance; be alert to phishing about these breaches.

why: Ransomware and state hacking now shut down hospitals, retailers, carmakers and airports for weeks.
drivers: Ransomware gangs, state actors, zero-days, supply-chain compromises.

rubric.alert: National-scale attack on critical infrastructure (power, health, finance), or a destructive state-attributed attack.
rubric.watch: Ransomware or attack disrupting a large company or critical service, or a mass-exploited zero-day.
rubric.normal: No major incidents disrupting critical services this week.
